titleEn: Break It in Half, Eat Together!

pages.text: "The last bread!" Little brother Mumu waddled to the kitchen table. Just one piece of fresh bread remained on the plate. He hugged it with both wings. "Mine!"
Big sister Dodo came over. "Mumu, just one bite for me too." He hugged the bread and turned away. "No! I'll eat it all alone!" Sadly, Dodo turned toward the kitchen doorstep.
Alone at the table, Mumu bit the bread. But strange! Even chewing and chewing, it had no taste. "Huh? Why isn't it tasty at all?" He stopped chewing and glanced sideways.
Mom dusted flour from her apron and sat beside him. "You have all the bread. Why such a sad face?" Mumu looked down. "It... has no taste."
Mom smiled and picked it up. "Delicious things taste better broken in half and shared." With both wings, she broke it. Two halves lay side by side.
Mumu took one half and waddled to the doorstep. "Dodo! I brought half. Let's eat together!" Still sitting, she looked back over a shoulder. Her eyes widened.
"One, break it in half! Two, offer it to my sister!" He placed half gently on her wing. "Break it in half, eat together!" Dodo tapped her half against his.
"Three, everyone eats together!" Side by side on the step, they ate. Oh? The same bread tasted a hundred times better! One flick of his tail. Mumu's heart felt soft and fluffy.
At snack time the next day, Mumu held jam bread in both wings and broke it. "One, break it in half! Two, offer it to my sister! Three, everyone eats together! Dodo, let's eat together!"
Mom hugged Mumu in her full wings. "You know how to share!" Break tasty food in half, and flavor and smiles both double. Looking at Dodo, Mumu called, "Break it in half, eat together!"
